paper_evidence: Algorithm 1 applies one DE trial and one genetic-learning trial per target and increases nFES by two
source_evidence: The archived CEDE source evaluates one DE population and then at most one genetic-learning candidate after the population loop
impact: Changes the operator ratio and search trajectory
resolution: Register paper_first and source_replay as separate semantics; use paper_first for the canonical clean-room implementation

paper_evidence: The paper trigger is defined from best-fitness improvement
source_evidence: The archived source initializes best fitness to zero and divides by that value during the first trigger calculation
impact: The first source trigger is undefined or non-finite
resolution: Use the mathematically defined relative-improvement trigger in paper_first; preserve the executable expression only in source_replay diagnostics

paper_evidence: The method retains better individuals during population reduction
source_evidence: The original CEDE.m ascending sort removes the best row; CEDE_recoding.m descending sort removes the worst row
impact: The original file reverses selection pressure
resolution: Use worst-individual removal in paper_first and record both source files and hashes

paper_evidence: Algorithm 1 reports nFES plus two per target while Eq. 19 requires the fitness of the separate Eq. 18 mutation
source_evidence: The archived source avoids that per-target mutation evaluation and therefore does not execute the stated paper comparison
impact: Counting only two calls cannot simultaneously execute the literal equations and count every objective call
resolution: Canonical paper-equation C++ counts DE trial mutation evaluation and final genetic candidate as three physical FES per complete target transition

paper_evidence: The paper describes probability-based selection among rand pbest and gbest strategies
source_evidence: The archived source assigns contiguous population blocks with fixed rounded quotas
impact: Changes which individual receives each mutation strategy
resolution: Register paper_first probability selection and source_replay fixed-block assignment separately

paper_evidence: The paper defines a random learning rate and a convex memory update together with a Lehmer mean for F
source_evidence: The archived source directly replaces one memory slot with weighted successful-parameter means
resolution: Register the two update rules as distinct semantic profiles; paper_first is canonical

paper_evidence: Equation 21 states that both resulting populations contain L divided by two individuals while Eq. 20 indexes samples with m times L and one-minus-m times L
source_evidence: The official source samples floor(m times L divided by two) superior rows and the complementary number of inferior rows to form one half-population
impact: Literal Eq. 20 would create a full population and contradict Eq. 21
resolution: Use the half-population cardinality required by Eq. 21 and verified by the official source

paper_evidence: Equation 23 uses mu equal to Imax divided by Imax plus Ic plus one which makes F increase; the surrounding prose says exploration should be stronger early
source_evidence: The official source uses Imax divided by Imax plus one minus Ic which makes F decrease
impact: The schedules produce materially different search trajectories
resolution: Register paper_equation and source_replay schedules separately; paper_equation is the current canonical profile

paper_evidence: The paper and driver call the method BDE
source_evidence: The official file BDE.m declares a function named RDE and the driver calls BDE
impact: The official package cannot execute under strict MATLAB function-name matching without a repair
resolution: Register the file hash and apply the minimal entry-name repair only in source-replay diagnostics

paper_evidence: The paper sets maximum FES to 10000 and states Imax equals two FES divided by L
source_evidence: The official driver uses L=50 and 400 iterations while evaluating 50 initial layouts plus 25 layouts per generation which totals 10050 physical evaluations
impact: Legacy iteration labels exceed the declared physical-work budget

paper_evidence: Equations 15-17 compare current particles and use two independent random coefficients
source_evidence: The local source compares personal-best states and uses one complementary mixing coefficient
resolution: Use the explicit paper operands and coefficients; retain per-coordinate peer sampling from source because the paper does not state peer reuse

paper_evidence: Equations 22a-22f define coordinate-wise equality and branch conditions
source_evidence: The local source tests full-vector equality and forces its first branch family during the first source iteration
impact: Changes which dimensions follow reference global or relay directions
resolution: Use the literal coordinate-wise paper cases without a first-iteration override

paper_evidence: Algorithm 1 places Eq. 21 after hierarchical trial construction and boundary repair
source_evidence: The local source calls replacement at the beginning of the loop using the previous population
impact: Changes the state acted on by the application-specific operator
resolution: Follow Algorithm 1 and rank current trial cells by accumulated cell-power evidence before evaluation

paper_evidence: Algorithm 1 increments nFEs by NP although Eq. 17 needs evaluated references and the final trial also needs evaluation
source_evidence: The local source counts both NP-sized batches internally but excludes initialization and drives termination by a twice-incremented iteration variable
